name: Basket Identification And Eligibility Set Profile 1
definition: Provides information on the baskets identification and the Eligibility Set Profile.

PreferentialBasketIdentificationNumber.name: Preferential Basket Identification Number
PreferentialBasketIdentificationNumber.definition: Number identifying the preferred collateral basket.

FallbackStartingBasketIdentification.name: Fallback Starting Basket Identification
FallbackStartingBasketIdentification.definition: Number identifying the fallback starting collateral basket.

ExclusionBasketIdentification.name: Exclusion Basket Identification
ExclusionBasketIdentification.definition: Number identifying the collateral basket to be excluded.

EligibilitySetProfile.name: Eligibility Set Profile
EligibilitySetProfile.definition: Number identifying the collateral eligibility set profile of the counterparty.
